base: Production 2D cutout animation RIG PARTS ATLAS for ONE enemy in HEXBLAST. Reference image 1 is the approved A STYLE; reference image 2 is B BRIGHTNESS ONLY. Match A's compact rounded sturdy silhouettes, clean thick dark navy outer lines, 2-3 clean cel-shaded color blocks, economical detail. Midtones clear, upper-left light. NO realistic rendering, skinny proportions, decorative spikes, MMORPG ornament, noise, effects, aura, shadow, UI or text. TRANSPARENT RGBA. EXACT GRID 6 columns x 3 rows, wide 2:1 canvas. Every cell has ONE ISOLATED COMPLETE component, separated by transparent padding at all cell edges; never cross boundaries. Row1 FRONT facing viewer slightly right; row2 SIDE facing RIGHT; row3 BACK facing away slightly right. The back row must show the rear, not another side. Disconnected pieces for local skeletal animation, NOT complete characters. Each row follows specified column order. Main torso includes head and pelvis, no attached arms or legs, filled shoulder/hip overlap. Each limb includes full rounded hidden attachment to rotate without holes. Keep all details and perspective consistent across rows. Body fills 80% of its cell height, limbs 55-65% height, accessory 40% height; never add extra components. No text or cell borders.

layouts.biped: Columns 1 HEAD+TORSO+PELVIS, without arms or legs. 2 FAR complete arm with weapon if described. 3 NEAR complete arm with weapon if described. 4 FAR complete leg with boot/claw. 5 NEAR complete leg with boot/claw. 6 alternate roaring/open-face HEAD (for machines: opened chest reactor module), same identity.
layouts.crawler: Columns 1 WHOLE rounded CENTRAL BODY including head/back, NO LEGS or claws. 2 FAR front claw/leg. 3 NEAR front claw/leg. 4 FAR rear walking leg. 5 NEAR rear walking leg. 6 upper shell/valve attachment. Each appendage an individual complete piece with round proximal joint.
layouts.quadruped: Columns 1 HORIZONTAL CENTRAL TORSO plus head/back armor, NO LEGS. 2 FAR FRONT LEG complete from shoulder to paw/hoof. 3 NEAR FRONT LEG complete. 4 FAR HIND LEG complete hip to paw. 5 NEAR HIND LEG complete. 6 HEAD alternate open-jaw or horn-lowered pose. Animal proportions and horizontal body, not human.
layouts.hover: Columns 1 CENTRAL TORSO plus head, NO arms/tails. 2 FAR ARM/electrode/shear complete. 3 NEAR ARM/electrode/shear complete. 4 FAR hanging tail/cable/robe segment. 5 NEAR hanging tail/cable/robe segment. 6 independent chest/halo/core accessory.
layouts.tentacle: Columns 1 CENTRAL MANTLE/BELL/RING plus face, NO TENTACLES. 2 FAR attack tentacle/claw, thick curved with round root. 3 NEAR attack tentacle/claw. 4 FAR lower supporting tentacle, thick short curl. 5 NEAR lower supporting tentacle. 6 alternate open mouth/core/inner bell module. No human limbs.
layouts.drone: Columns 1 CENTRAL FUSELAGE with eye, no engines or guns/manipulators. 2 FAR side engine pod. 3 NEAR side engine pod. 4 FAR underslung gun/manipulator. 5 NEAR underslung gun/manipulator. 6 top sensor/antenna module.

refinementNotes.rust_biter: 低水平兽躯，去除药罐和胸核，并去除躯干上附着的足部。
refinementNotes.chain_hound: 独立机械犬、背部链条绞盘，去除肉体与药罐。
refinementNotes.bell_devourer: 以铜钟本体为头胸、钟口为嘴，紫色短肢，去除类人怪物躯干。
refinementNotes.prism_snail: 分离躯干上重复的足部，闭壳稿用于防御动作。
refinementNotes.boss_invader: 保持独立白灰机甲，移除所有背景灰雾。
